# Digi-Tec Performance Centre

> Digi-Tec Performance Centre is Dubai's leading independent workshop for European and luxury cars, based in Al Quoz Industrial Area 3 since 2009. Specialists in Mercedes-Benz, Maybach, BMW, Audi, Porsche, Ferrari, Lamborghini, McLaren, Bentley, Rolls-Royce, Bugatti, Aston Martin, and Land Rover / Range Rover. Rated 4.9★ from 312+ verified owners.

## Contact

- Phone / WhatsApp: +971 4 340 2223
- Address: Al Quoz Industrial Area 3, Warehouse No. 11-15, Dubai, UAE
- Website: https://digitecme.com

## Key facts

- 15+ years of specialisation on German, British, and Italian luxury cars
- Factory-level diagnostic equipment: XENTRY, ISTA+, PIWIS 3, ODIS, LDAS, SD3, JLR SDD
- Genuine OEM parts with invoice traceability
- Typically 30–50% less than main-dealer prices
- Free collection and delivery across Dubai
- 12-month warranty on parts and labour
